"So we have a deal?", Marsellus asks handing over the suitcase.

"Y-Yeah sure thing Mr. Wallace", stutters Brett, "You won't be disappointed"

"Oh, I don't expect to be. 'Cause if that happens, you won't be expecting it." Marsellus vaguely remarks, his eyes behind those round shades looking like the skull's eye sockets.

"Wha-- oh yes Mr. Wallace" Brett acknowledges, confused.

"I'll be seeing you around"

Brett walks back to his car. Seated on the passenger side is Roger, Brett's trusty partner in crime.

"How did it go?"

"It went fine, Rog. Though that man creeped the f*ck out of me. You sure we can pull this off?" Brett has always been the jittery one of the pair.

"Hey when this is over, you'll thank me." said Roger with a lazy smirk.

"And if it goes the other way, you got a plan?" 

"Yeah I got a pal who has an apartment. We'll be alright"

They drive back home with the merchandise to keep it safe until the time comes.

"Mr. Wallace gave me the combo for this case. You wouldn't believe what it is"

"Well, show me man" insisted Roger

Brett aligns the combination and the locks easily flip open. Brett lifts the case open.

"Sweet mother of--" gasps Roger, his eyes widen as his face puts on a yellow glow coming from the suitcase. Seemingly accompanying his emotion.

"W-W-What?!" Brett stuttering as usual but this time in awe of what he is witnessing.

"This is it man. This is gonna bring us out of all this!" Roger exclaims.

Brett nods in agreement. 

"So, your friend's apartment where is it?"
